name: github-issues-kanban
description: Use when the user wants agent-driven task orchestration on GitHub Issues/Projects V2 — says "kanban", "board", "dispatch next", "claim issue", "triage my inbox", "audit my board", "list boards", "set up a sprint board", "what should I work on", "/github-issues-kanban", mentions GitHub Projects, or asks for multiple agents working issues in parallel. Also when claims go stale, dispatches conflict, or a board needs a health check before unattended runs.
